use default
use Raster.Anchor
use Raster.IMAGE

use SPOT = (x: double, y: double)

union Huffman(weight: int) is
    LEAF(symbol: char, ..)
    NODE(left: Huffman, right: Huffman, ..)
si

use Huffman.LEAF
use Huffman.NODE

take_lightest(pending: LIST[Huffman]) -> Huffman is
    let at mut = 0

    for i in 1..pending.count do
        if pending[i].weight < pending[at].weight then
            at = i
        fi
    od

    let lightest = pending[at]

    pending.remove_at(at)

    return lightest
si

build_tree(leaves: List[Huffman]) -> Huffman is
    let pending = LIST(leaves)

    while pending.count > 1 do
        let first = take_lightest(pending)
        let second = take_lightest(pending)

        pending.add(NODE(first, second, first.weight + second.weight))
    od

    return pending[0]
si

let text = "this is an example for huffman encoding"

let weights = MAP()

for character in text do
    let seen mut = 0

    weights.try_get_value(character, seen ref)

    weights[character] = seen + 1
od

let leaves = LIST()

for symbol in weights.keys |> sort() do
    leaves.add(LEAF(symbol, weights[symbol]))
od

let tree = build_tree(leaves)

let marks = LIST[(at: SPOT, symbol: char, weight: int)]()
let edges = LIST[(from: SPOT, to: SPOT, bit: string)]()

let next_leaf mut = 0.0

place(node: Huffman, depth: int) -> SPOT =>
    if let leaf: LEAF = node then
        (let at = (x = next_leaf, y = -cast double(depth))

         next_leaf = next_leaf + 1.0
         marks.add((at = at, symbol = leaf.symbol, weight = leaf.weight))

         at)
    else
        (let left = place(node.left, depth + 1)
         let right = place(node.right, depth + 1)

         let at = (x = (left.x + right.x) / 2.0, y = -cast double(depth))

         edges.add((from = at, to = left, bit = "0"))
         edges.add((from = at, to = right, bit = "1"))

         at)
    fi

let root = place(tree, 0)

let deepest = marks |> map(mark => -mark.at.y) |> max() ?? 0.0

let image = IMAGE(900, 360)

image.view(-0.7, -deepest - 1.1, next_leaf - 0.3, 0.5, 14.0)

image.colour(120ub, 140ub, 190ub)
image.stroke(1.6)

for edge in edges do
    image.line(edge.from.x, edge.from.y, edge.to.x, edge.to.y)
od

image.colour(120ub, 120ub, 120ub)

for edge in edges do
    let x = (edge.from.x * 2.0 + edge.to.x) / 3.0
    let y = (edge.from.y * 2.0 + edge.to.y) / 3.0
    let aside = if edge.bit =~ "0" then -0.16 else 0.16 fi

    image.text(x + aside, y, 11.0, edge.bit, Anchor.CENTRE)
od

for edge in edges do
    image.colour(150ub, 150ub, 150ub)
    image.stroke(5.0)
    image.line(edge.from.x, edge.from.y, edge.from.x, edge.from.y)
od

for mark in marks do
    let shown =
        if mark.symbol == ' ' then "space" else "{mark.symbol}" fi

    image.colour(30ub, 70ub, 160ub)
    image.stroke(9.0)
    image.line(mark.at.x, mark.at.y, mark.at.x, mark.at.y)

    image.colour(30ub, 30ub, 30ub)
    image.text(mark.at.x, mark.at.y - 0.42, 15.0, shown, Anchor.CENTRE)

    image.colour(120ub, 120ub, 120ub)
    image.text(mark.at.x, mark.at.y - 0.82, 12.0, "{mark.weight}",
               Anchor.CENTRE)
od

image.write("huffman.png")

image.show("huffman.png")
